shortlist.label: Breast Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's presentation of a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins and the imaging findings of a homogeneously hyperechoic mass are consistent with a lipoma.

shortlist.label: Hamartoma of the Breast
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's age and the presence of a well-defined, soft mass with a heterogeneous lucent appearance on mammography are consistent with a hamartoma.

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's age and the presence of a well-defined, soft mass are consistent with a fibroadenoma, although the size of the mass is larger than typical.

shortlist.label: Phyllodes Tumor
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's presentation of a large, well-defined mass with a heterogeneous appearance on imaging is consistent with a phyllodes tumor, although the lack of skin changes or nipple discharge makes this less likely.

shortlist.label: Pseudoangiomatous Stromal Hyperplasia (PASH)
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's presentation of a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins and the imaging findings of a homogeneous T1- and T2-hyperintense mass are consistent with PASH.

raw.rationale: The clinical and imaging findings, including a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins, a homogeneously hyperechoic mass on ultrasonography, and a heterogeneous lucent mass on mammography, are consistent with a hamartoma of the breast. The mass's encapsulation with multiple thin septa and lack of thoracic extension or bony erosion also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Breast Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipomas are typically smaller and less well-defined than the mass described in this case.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Fibroadenomas are usually smaller and more mobile than the mass in this case, and they often have a more heterogeneous appearance on imaging.

rejected.label: Phyllodes Tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors can be large and well-defined, but they often have a more complex appearance on imaging, with cystic areas, calcifications, or internal vascularity, which are not present in this case.

rejected.label: Pseudoangiomatous Stromal Hyperplasia (PASH)
rejected.why: PASH typically presents as a diffuse or multinodular lesion, rather than a well-defined mass, and it often has a more heterogeneous appearance on imaging.
